#collab There is a new way that CAs are making money in the country...

And this is not through tax cases or audits and accounting... but this new service that your CA should start too...

Most small and medium Indian businesses use accounting software like Tally, Busy, Zoho... but their biggest pain point is that even though they want to automate business processes like tax reconciliations, cash flow management and MIS reporting, or even things like attendance, and payroll...

They don’t want to pay extra for software... and are afraid of implementing ERP softwares that cost upwards of Rs 20 lakhs in implementation...

And now a new service has come in the market, where people are using AI tools to build custom business automation at a fraction of the cost...

For example, without knowing any coding, I’ve been playing with AI Tools and have already built tools for:

- GST and TDS reconciliation with books of accounts
- WhatsApp Payment Recovery agent for pending invoices
- Accounting Dashboard for automated accounting and reporting from bank statements

It’s something that you can build at a fraction of the cost, but charge upwards of Rs 1 lakh to your clients and businesses...

For example, I would urge you to visit emergent <dot> sh, and ask it to build an app with all the features that you want...

The app asks you simple questions that you can answer, and it not just builds the app, but tests it, and deploys it for you as well.

So Accounts and Business Process Automation is the easiest things that CAs can start building products around and either sell it to clients at a one time fee, or charge basic monthly subscriptions for.
